artists.biography: Jonathan Wilson (born December 30, 1974, in Forest City, North Carolina) is an American singer/songwriter/multi-instrumentalist/producer who is now based in Los Angeles.  Wilson completed a solo album entitled, Frankie Ray in 2007 that was never officially released. Since then, Wilson has recorded the full length album, Gentle Spirit, which was released in 2011. The same year, Wilson was named Uncut Magazine's 2011 "New Artist of the Year".   Wilson's early experiences was as co-founder pf the band muscadine with Benji Hughes in 1995. The band released their debut album, The Ballad of Hope Nicholls, in 1998.  Wilson's recording studio, Five Star Studio, in Echo Park, Los Angeles, is renowned for its sound and analog recording equipment.  www.songsofjonathanwilson.com

perplexity.description:
Dixie Blur," released on March 6, 2020, is the fourth studio album by American musician and producer Jonathan Wilson, issued through Bella Union and BMG. The album blends elements of folk, world, and country music, reflecting Wilson's Southern roots both musically and personally. Recorded in Nashville at Cowboy Jack Clement's Sound Emporium Studio A, "Dixie Blur" showcases a warm, introspective sound that draws on the Laurel Canyon mellow rock tradition of the late 1960s and early 1970s, while incorporating modern sensibilities and diverse instrumentation.

Within Wilson's discography, "Dixie Blur" stands out as a mature and cohesive work that balances lush arrangements with intimate songwriting. It received generally favorable critical reception, earning an aggregate score of 80/100 on Metacritic based on six mainstream reviews, with praise for its rich textures and emotional depth. Commercially, the album performed well on several charts, including reaching number one on the UK Americana Albums chart and charting in Germany and Scotland. This release further solidified Wilson's reputation as a skilled multi-instrumentalist and producer capable of crafting evocative, genre-spanning music.
